evidence.claim: Mangusta è nata nel 1985 dalla famiglia Balducci e costruisce yacht in Toscana tra Massa, Viareggio e Pisa su circa 210.000 metri quadri.
evidence.quote: The Balducci family founded Mangusta in 1985, choosing a symbolic and meaningful name for the company. || Located in Tuscany near Massa, Viareggio and Pisa, the company’s various production sites total approximately 210,000 square metres and closely control every step entailed in building a new yacht.
